_comment: The FARIZUL plate scanner is a separate Next.js deployment, because it
needs a server for its database and plate-reader keys and this site is
plain static files. These rewrites hand /farizul.html and everything
under /farizul/ over to that deployment, so visitors stay on
www.farizuljaafar.com the whole time and never see the other address.
Same-origin matters here: the scanner asks for camera permission, and
asking as farizuljaafar.com is far more reliable than asking from a
There is deliberately no farizul.html file in this repo any more. Vercel
checks real files BEFORE rewrites, so a file of that name would win and
The scanner app sets basePath '/farizul', so its pages, assets and API
routes all live under that prefix and one wildcard rule covers them.
